ios_min.requirement_text: To use RCS, you need iOS 18 and a cellular plan from a carrier that supports RCS messaging on iPhone.
ios_min.note: Base person-to-person requirement. Carrier rollouts can require a later release.

iphone_models.requirement_text: iOS 18 is compatible with the following iPhone models:
iphone_models.note: Apple lists iPhone XS, XS Max, XR, and SE (2nd generation or later) among compatible models.

android_google_messages_setup.requirement_text: Make sure that Google Messages is your device’s default app for SMS.
android_google_messages_setup.note: Install or update Google Messages from Play, set it as the default Short Message Service (SMS) app, update Google Play services, and use an eligible verified number, data and Google or carrier service. Google recommends the latest app and gives no universal minimum app build for service.

android_google_play_services_floor.requirement_text: Google Play services are only supported on devices with Android 7.0 (API level 24) and up.
android_google_play_services_floor.note: Google’s supported Play services floor. Devices need a usable Google services setup for the documented Google Messages route.
